target_customer: Patent litigators at law firms and in-house teams
problem: Patent litigation work such as prior art search and claim charts is manual.
product_category: Legal AI workspace for patent litigation

founders.name: Caleb Harris
founders.background_notes: Technical consulting in patent litigation per YC page.

founders.name: Herbert Turner
education: MIT, aerospace engineering and computer science

technical_complexity.rationale: Claim charting and patent search over large corpora with litigation grade accuracy is standard LLM engineering with hard domain parts.

defensibility.rationale: Workflow and litigator advisory network help, but several funded patent AI rivals exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Solve Intelligence added a litigation product in December 2025 and Patlytics raised a 40M Series B in April 2026; direct competition grew.

market_need_then: Patent attorneys faced manual workflows and ILTA profiles describe firsthand observation of that burden.

branding.domain_note: Uses tryandai.com, a try prefix, because &AI is not a valid domain.

identity.logo: Ampersand AI wordmark (not described in detail)

branding.community_and_virality: Legal trade press coverage including Artificial Lawyer.

brand_strength.rationale: Symbol name is hard to type and search, though Andy gives a character.

outcome_analysis: &AI joined YC in Summer 2024 and announced a 6.5 million dollar First Round-led seed in February 2025, then positioned an agent named Andy for patent litigators with an eight-litigator advisory board. Domain-savvy founders and strong investors are positives, but patent AI competitors raised larger rounds later and no traction figures were published.
notes: No dated competitor source near June 2024 was found; later rivals are described in outcome_analysis. Seed corroborated by Artificial Lawyer and The AI Insider. Search also surfaced a mislabeled Series B on Sacra that belongs to Patlytics. Name origin not found; reading & as And is an inference, not recorded.
